task_text: A typhoon is coming in 10 minutes. Seal up the house completely.

Receive and hold a lightweight sealing item if a visiting robot needs it staged within my reach
need_from_others: ASK_HELP: A mobile robot with closure-manipulation capability must immediately enter the kitchen, fully close and latch or lock the window over the sink, and secure any kitchen door that leads outside.
R1.obs_scope: I can observe the kitchen counters, island, window, and two kitchen doors shown by my cameras, plus the listed objects in occluded kitchen areas. I cannot see other rooms, determine from here whether either door leads outdoors, or verify any opening elsewhere in the house.

Inspect or secure openings outside the kitchen because I cannot navigate

R1.reasoning: 1. GOAL STATE: Before the 10-minute deadline, every exterior opening—including the kitchen window and any exterior kitchen door—must be fully closed and locked or latched so wind and rain cannot enter. 2. PRIORITY: Closing and securing exterior openings is the immediate life-and-property safety priority; optional storm organization is secondary. 3. MY CONTRIBUTION: The kitchen window is in my room, but my fixed gripper lacks the ability to navigate or operate and latch it, so a capable mobile robot must seal it. I can hand lightweight kitchen objects to a robot that comes here if one is required. 4. MY OBJECTS: I see kitchenware, food, small appliances, and cleaning items, but no clearly suitable boarding or sealing material. The dish sponge is not a dependable exterior seal, so I am not suggesting it as essential sealing equipment.
